Timeline/1950

Foundations

The imitation game

Turing reframed the question of machine intelligence through an operational test based on conversation.

Alan M. Turing

The contribution

Instead of relying on a single definition of thinking, Turing proposed an imitation game and examined objections to machine intelligence. His discussion also considered learning machines, making the paper a foundational inquiry into how machine behavior might be evaluated.

What this does not establish

The imitation game is a proposed evaluation, not a proof of consciousness or a complete definition of intelligence.

Why this date?

The journal issue is dated 1 October 1950.
